release_notes: Formations begin visibly offset, then a gravity flip locks and banks them onto the projected firing path.
Added a visible trajectory rail, lock pulses, dashed approach guides, sync rings, cues, scoring, and impact feedback.
Rebuilt the five encounter families as echo arc, dive, cross, sprint, and hunt patterns with distinct spacing and acceleration.
Direct runtime playtest improved from 11 kills and a maximum chain of two to 21 kills, every formation cleared, all lives retained, and a six-kill chain using one flip per cue.
Added `formation_synced`, `sync_kills`, and `max_sync_chain` telemetry while retaining previous compatibility fields.
Added sustained trajectory-error assertions and a multi-formation real-runtime playtest that rejects input-mashing-dependent behavior.
Validation passed: `npm test`, `npm run build`, and `git diff --check`.
